A '''permacrete detonator''' was an explosive powerful enough to destroy [[Permacrete/Legends|permacrete]]. It was recommended that only one with a vast knowledge of demolitions set it up.

In [[3956 BBY]] a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] named [[Matrik]], who had a bounty on his head, asked [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] to help him fake his death to get the [[Exchange]] off his back. This involved Revan purchasing a permacrete detonator from [[Kebla Yurt]]'s store and having Matrik set it up. When Matrik Detonated it, It exploded more than once, with two small explosions and then a final larger explosion.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>
